messages:
deploybot: Canary rollout finished: runtime-engine@v3.2.0-quant-kv -> 5% traffic in us-west-2 (slice A). Observed: small increase in tail latency and a spike in KV cache miss rate for ql8 models. Logs: `kv_miss_rate +14%`, `p99 latency +120ms`

marta: saw the alert. linking traces now. is this the new matmul/quant combo?

simon: yes, this build includes the new quant kernels + smaller KV cache packing change. we expected perf but might have introduced eviction churn for longer contexts.

avery: can you paste the smoke logs? if it's only ql8 traffic maybe we can restrict rollout to non-ql8 models.

deploybot: Smoke log snippet (from canary agent):
```
[2026-03-19T22:05:12Z] model=ql8c shard=srv-17 kv_miss_rate=0.312 prev=0.273 p99=0.852s prev_p99=0.732s err_rate=0.01
[2026-03-19T22:06:00Z] model=gpt-small shard=srv-12 kv_miss_rate=0.041 p99=0.112s
```

paul-oncall: i'm oncall. what's the recommendation? pin previous engine? rollback?

marta: i'd prefer a scoped pin for ql8 model routing first. fallback to full rollback if no improvement in 20m.

simon: agree. we can pin routing for us-west-2 slice A to runtime-engine@v3.1.7 (the last known-good) with the deploybot command: `#pin-route us-west-2 slice-A runtime-engine v3.1.7 --reason="ql8 kv-eviction spike"`

jeff: can we instead tweak cache tuning on v3.2.0 to avoid churn? that would be lower blast radius but needs a hot build. timeline?

avery: hot tune would take ~2h to validate. not good for current surge. pin+investigate sounds safest.

paul-oncall: do the pin. I'll monitor SLOs and hit rollback if p99 stays > +80ms after 20m.

marta: @deploybot execute pin: `pin-runtime us-west-2 slice-A runtime-engine v3.1.7`

deploybot: Acknowledged. Pin requested by marta. Executing...

deploybot: Pin complete. Route slice-A -> runtime-engine@v3.1.7. Old routing saved as `v3.2.0-canary-backup-2417654321`

jeff: thanks. please also add a short note to release-notes: "v3.2.0: enabled new quant kernels; observed KV cache eviction regression for long-context ql8 variants in early canaries; routing pin in us-west-2 slice A while we investigate."

marta: i'll add the note and a follow-up action item: `investigate cache packing heuristics + revert candidate if can't reproduce locally`

ops-bot: created ticket REM-4821 "kv eviction regression on v3.2.0 for ql8" assigned to eng-runtime-replay, priority P2

paul-oncall: setting a 30m watch window. if p99 > +80ms at 30m -> initiate rollback plan B (global rollback to v3.1.7).

simon: i'll start a local replay focused on ql8 long-context and push telemetry dump to the ticket.

avery: ping me if you hit nondeterministic evictions, i'll run a memory profile.

marta: final note: update the changelog entry and add the canary metrics snapshot to the ticket before we close the watch window.

jeff: ack. thanks all :thumbsup:

paul-oncall: thanks. will post final status in 30m or earlier if we hit rollback.
